title: APEXFIN silver point
description: The normalized unit of data. Third-party extractors must emit objects matching this schema.

event_time.description: Business time in UTC. This is the time the observation refers to, NOT the time it was fetched. Getting this wrong is the root cause of the silent-staleness failure class.

event_date.description: Trading-day key derived from event_time. Stored separately so freshness and continuity checks can use an index.

value.description: The single number this row means. Nulls are not allowed: a missing observation must be absent as a row, not present as a null.

is_filled.description: True only if produced by an explicit fill step. Silent forward-fill is prohibited; filled rows are visibly marked on the dashboard.
